field.label: App Categories
field.help: Search and select app categories or individual apps

field.label: Custom Domains
field.help: Comma-separated domains (e.g. example.com, cdn.test.org). All subdomains matched automatically.

field.label: Gateway
field.help: Select gateways in priority order (first = highest priority, last = fallback)

field.label: Smart Gateway
field.help: Enable automatic gateway probing and failover (requires 2+ gateways)

field.label: Probe URL
field.help: http(s) URL to test through each gateway. Leave empty to use https://www.google.com. Examples: https://www.iqiyi.com/ (video), https://music.163.com/ (music)

field.label: Probe Interval
field.help: Seconds between probes (30-3600, default 300). Lower = faster failover but more traffic

field.label: Probe Method
field.help: Connect: TCP reachability. Status Code: HTTP 403/451 = blocked. Body Match: regex on response body. Latency: pick fastest gateway

field.label: Probe Pattern
field.help: Regex to detect geo-restriction in response body. Match = blocked. Example: 地区限制|not available|geo.restricted
